title: Wall St ends higher on cool inflation data, strong earnings
title_zh: 通胀数据温和、盈利强劲，华尔街收高

title: What rising memory chip prices could mean for Apple's iPhones
title_zh: 存储芯片价格上涨对苹果 iPhone 意味着什么
summary: US stocks (^GSPC, ^DJI, ^IXIC) managed to close Wednesday's session higher despite a new sell-off appearing across the semiconductor industry.
summary_zh: 尽管半导体行业出现新一轮抛售，但美国股市（^GSPC、^DJI、^IXIC）周三收盘走高。

title: OpenAI's AI speaker marks its entry into consumer hardware
title_zh: OpenAI的AI音箱标志着其进军消费类硬件
summary: Yahoo Finance Tech Editor discusses OpenAI's (OPAI.PVT) first consumer hardware device, an AI-powered smart speaker, breaking down what the product could offer and what it means for the company's push into consumer hardware and the broader AI race.
summary_zh: 雅虎财经技术编辑讨论了 OpenAI (OPAI.PVT) 的首款消费类硬件设备，即一款人工智能驱动的智能扬声器，详细介绍了该产品可以提供的功能，以及它对于该公司进军消费类硬件和更广泛的人工智能竞赛的意义。

title: YieldMax launches a new SpaceX options ETF: What investors should know
title_zh: YieldMax 推出新的 SpaceX 期权 ETF：投资者应了解的信息
summary: SpaceX (SPCX) dropped below its IPO price on Wednesday, sinking below $140 per share.
summary_zh: SpaceX (SPCX) 周三跌破 IPO 价格，跌破每股 140 美元。

title: Tech trade check-in: What's behind all the recent rotation?
title_zh: 科技交易检查：近期轮换背后的原因是什么？
summary: Yahoo Finance Markets and Data Editor Jared Blikre takes a closer look at the tech sector's recent market action, highlighting why Big Tech earnings will be so significant.
summary_zh: 雅虎金融市场和数据编辑 Jared Blikre 仔细研究了科技行业最近的市场走势，强调了为什么大型科技公司的盈利如此可观。

title: Apple, Goldman Sachs, and Chevron are powering the Dow — for wildly different reasons: AlphaCheck
title_zh: 苹果、高盛和雪佛龙正在为道琼斯指数提供动力——原因截然不同：AlphaCheck
summary: The Dow has barely budged in July. Its leaders have broken away.
summary_zh: 道指在 7 月份几乎没有变化。它的领导人已经脱离了。

title: Does the PayPal takeover deal make any sense?
title_zh: PayPal 收购交易有意义吗？
summary: In today's Opening Bid panel, our guests tackle the Question of the Day: Is PayPal (PYPL) worth the price? Following reports of a potential offer to acquire the struggling payments company, the panel examines whether the stock is an attractive buy.
summary_zh: 在今天的开标小组中，我们的嘉宾解决了当天的问题：PayPal (PYPL) 值这个价格吗？在有报道称可能要约收购这家陷入困境的支付公司后，委员会审查了该股票是否具有吸引力。

title: Experts weigh the risks and rewards of Paramount-WBD deal
title_zh: 专家权衡派拉蒙与 WBD 交易的风险和回报
summary: Opening Bid's stock of the day is Paramount (PSKY).
summary_zh: 开盘当天的股票是派拉蒙 (PSKY)。

title: Why ASML's sales forecast lift is a 'real vote of confidence' for the AI trade
title_zh: 为什么 ASML 的销售预测提升是对人工智能行业的“真正的信任票”
summary: AI chip equipment maker ASML (ASML) raised its annual sales forecast amid growing demand. Defiance ETFs chief investment officer Sylvia Jablonski and Yahoo Finance Breaking Business News Reporter Jake Conley sit down with Yahoo Finance's Julie Hyman to discuss.
summary_zh: AI芯片设备制造商ASML（ASML）因需求不断增长而上调了年度销售预期。 Defiance ETF 首席投资官 Sylvia Jablonski 和雅虎财经突发商业新闻记者 Jake Conley 与雅虎财经的 Julie Hyman 坐下来进行讨论。
